item: A pytest that a test starts in a child process takes its own data directory, never its parent worker's live one
summary: tests/test_search_advanced_fixture_order.py ran a child pytest with the whole environment, and the conftest re-isolated only xdist workers holding the controller's directory, so the child booted the app on the worker's live database from a second process (eleven files appeared in it). On macOS shard 3 the worker's later tests then failed with disk I/O error on every new connection (runs 44711379902, 44719679495; 19 failures on gw3). Every process now marks the directory it made its own and any process inheriting a marked one takes its own; a directory set on purpose is kept. Red before in a plain run and under xdist. Test only, no user-facing change.
